BOOK ONE · LESSON 085

Paris in the spring

巴黎之春

A dialogue lesson on the present perfect tense (have/has been to). George and Ken meet outside a cinema; Ken has just been to the cinema to see 'Paris in the Spring', a film George has already seen on television. Ken says Paris is a beautiful city, but the weather was awful — it rained all the time, just like London. Workbook practice covers comprehension questions and a fill-in exercise with to/to the, on/on the, and in phrases. Grammar exercises practise do/did/done, giving replies to telephone calls, and completing present-perfect dialogues.

READ & UNDERSTAND

Lesson 课文

Listen then answer this question.
At what time of year did Ken visit Paris?
听录音，然后回答问题。肯是在什么季节访问巴黎的？

Listen to the recording, then answer: At what time of year did Ken visit Paris?

  1. 1

    GEORGE

    Hello, Ken.

    乔治：你好，肯。

  2. 2

    KEN

    Hi, George.

    肯：你好，乔治。

  3. 3

    GEORGE

    Have you just been to the cinema?

    乔治：你刚去过电影院吗？

  4. 4

    KEN

    Yes, I have.

    肯：是的，我刚去过。

  5. 5

    GEORGE

    What's on?

    乔治：上映什么片子？

  6. 6

    KEN

    'Paris in the Spring'.

    肯：《巴黎之春》。

  7. 7

    GEORGE

    Oh, I've already seen it.
    I saw it
    on television last year.
    It's an old film, but it's very good.

    乔治：噢，我已看过了。我是去年在电视上看的。这是部老片子，但很好。

  8. 8

    KEN

    Paris is a beautiful city.

    肯：巴黎是座美丽的城市。

  9. 9

    GEORGE

    I've never been there.
    Have you ever been there, Ken?

    乔治：我从未去过。肯，你去过吗？

  10. 10

    KEN

    Yes, I have.
    I was there in April.

    肯：是的，我去过。4月份我在那儿。

  11. 11

    GEORGE

    Paris in the spring, eh?

    乔治：那是巴黎之春，是吗？

  12. 12

    KEN

    It was spring,
    but the weather was awful.
    It rained all the time.

    肯：是春天，但天气太糟了。一直在下雨。

  13. 13

    GEORGE

    Just like London!

    乔治：就像伦敦一样！

Notes on the text 课文注释

1

have been to ...，到过……。“到过那里”则说 have been there。注意，在这里我们讲 to the cinema，同时也说 to the park，但在第55课中，我们有 to work, to school 的短语。在名词 school, work, church 之前不加定冠词 the。

2

What's on? 上演什么电影？

3

eh /eɪ/，感叹词，在此表示疑问。读升调。

4

all the time，一直，始终。

5

Just like London!
这是省略句，完整的句子为 Paris was just like London。其中的 just 有“正好”、“恰恰是”的意思。
而在第3行的 Have you just been to ... 中 just 是指时间，有“刚才”的意思。

参考译文
乔治：你好，肯。
肯：你好，乔治。
乔治：你刚去过电影院吗？
肯：是的，我刚去过。
乔治：上映什么片子？
肯：《巴黎之春》。
乔治：噢，我已看过了。我是去年在电视上看的。这是部老片子，但很好。
肯：巴黎是座美丽的城市。
乔治：我从未去过。肯，你去过吗？
肯：是的，我去过。4月份我在那儿。
乔治：那是巴黎之春，是吗？
肯：是春天，但天气太糟了。一直在下雨。
乔治：就像伦敦一样！
